newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Steel plans Mexican service center.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Steel plans Mexican service center.

text.p: United States Steel International Inc said Tuesday it has tentatively agreed with Preussag Stahl AG's Feralloy Corp and Intacero de Mexico SA de CV to form a service center venture in San Luis Potosi, Mexico.

The USX Corp subsidiary said the venture will be a qualified bonded warehouse that will initially provide the services of slitting coiled steel sheet and warehousing it for just-in-time delivery to Mexican consumers. The facility will be equipped with a 72 inch wide slitting line with production expected to begin during the second half of 1998.
It said Feralloy will be the operating partner, Intacero will market the products and services, and U.S. Steel will participate in the supply of flat-rolled steel products to the joint venture.
